name: Image-Composition-Dataset-MureCom
description: Comprehensive Dataset for Image Composition & Object Insertion

paragraphs: Welcome to scan the WeChat QR code to join the discussion group on image composition/compositing, object insertion/addition.

To support fine-tuning open-source foundation image editing model for varied image composition and object insertion tasks, we built the maximally comprehensive dataset MureCom with ongoing improvements. The term "comprehensive" here does not refer to dataset scale, but rather the diversity of data types.

Our MureCom dataset can be downloaded from [[Dropbox]]( or [[Baidu Cloud]]( Note that MureCom is extended from our previous FOSCom dataset. This folder consists of 32 category subfolders, where each subfolder contains the following data:
features: Backgrounds: Each subfolder includes 20 background images suitable for that category. These background images are stored in the bg folder together with their bounding boxes to insert the foreground object.

Foregrounds: Each subfolder includes 3 sets of foreground images, in which each set contains 5 images for the same foreground object. Three sets of foreground images are stored in the fg1, fg2, and fg3 folders together…
